
### socket options  {.smaller}


* ‘socket options’ for extra settings
* Python: <code>sock.setsockopt(level, key, value)</code> 

   * e.g. <code>sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)</code>

* C: <code>setsockopt(sock, level, key, value)</code> 

   * e.g. <code>setsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, 1)</code>
 
<hr class="vspace" />
* common level values 

   * <code>SOL_SOCKET</code> --- OS-level
   * <code>IPPROTO_IP</code>
   * <code>IPPROTO_IPV6</code>
   * <code>IPPROTO_TCP</code>



### common SOL_SOCKET options  {.smaller}


* <code>SO_REUSEADDR</code> --- allow bind()ing even if another socket for this port active 

   * common problem: server can't bind() because old session in TIME_WAIT

* <code>SO_RCVBUF</code> --- buffer size used by OS for receiving bytes
* <code>SO_SNDBUF</code> --- buffer size used by OS for sending bytes
* <code>SO_LINGER</code> --- make close() wait until messages acknowleged or timeout 
<hr class="vspace" />
* (full list on Linux: <code>man 7 socket</code>)
